visits_scheduled_check.name: visits_scheduled_check
visits_scheduled_check.value: "status" NOT IN ('scheduled', 'completed', 'no_show') OR "scheduled_at" IS NOT NULL

commission_entries_charge_check.name: commission_entries_charge_check
commission_entries_charge_check.value: "kind" <> 'charge' OR ("amount" >= 0 AND "rate_percent" IS NOT NULL AND "basis" IS NOT NULL AND "deal_value" IS NOT NULL)

commission_rates_default_check.name: commission_rates_default_check
commission_rates_default_check.value: "organization_id" IS NOT NULL OR ("basis" IS NOT NULL AND "percent" IS NOT NULL)

subscriptions_active_check.name: subscriptions_active_check
subscriptions_active_check.value: "status" <> 'active' OR ("current_period_start" IS NOT NULL AND "current_period_end" IS NOT NULL)

subscriptions_paused_check.name: subscriptions_paused_check
subscriptions_paused_check.value: "status" <> 'paused' OR ("paused_at" IS NOT NULL AND "paused_from" IN ('trialing', 'pending_payment', 'active'))

listings_offer_check.name: listings_offer_check
listings_offer_check.value: ("offer_title" IS NULL AND "offer_details" IS NULL AND "offer_valid_until" IS NULL) OR ("offer_title" IS NOT NULL AND char_length("offer_title") BETWEEN 2 AND 60 AND coalesce(char_length("offer_details"), 0) <= 280)

contact_messages_length_check.name: contact_messages_length_check
contact_messages_length_check.value: char_length("name") BETWEEN 2 AND 120 AND char_length("message") BETWEEN 20 AND 4000

legal_requests_length_check.name: legal_requests_length_check
legal_requests_length_check.value: char_length("name") BETWEEN 2 AND 120 AND char_length("location") BETWEEN 3 AND 200 AND ("details" IS NULL OR char_length("details") <= 2000)

notifications_link_check.name: notifications_link_check
notifications_link_check.value: "link" IS NULL OR ("link" LIKE '/%' AND "link" NOT LIKE '//%')

properties_building_unit_unique.name: properties_building_unit_unique
properties_building_unit_unique.where: "deleted_at" IS NULL AND "building_id" IS NOT NULL AND "unit_number" IS NOT NULL

properties_area_order_check.name: properties_area_order_check
properties_area_order_check.value:
("carpet_area_sqft" IS NULL OR "built_up_area_sqft" IS NULL OR "carpet_area_sqft" <= "built_up_area_sqft")
      AND ("built_up_area_sqft" IS NULL OR "super_built_up_area_sqft" IS NULL OR "built_up_area_sqft" <= "super_built_up_area_sqft")

bookings_dates_check.name: bookings_dates_check
bookings_dates_check.value: NOT isempty("dates") AND lower_inc("dates") AND NOT upper_inc("dates") AND upper("dates") - lower("dates") = "nights"

bookings_cancelled_by_check.name: bookings_cancelled_by_check
bookings_cancelled_by_check.value: (("status" = 'cancelled') = ("cancelled_by" IS NOT NULL)) AND ("cancelled_by" IS NULL OR "cancelled_by" IN ('guest', 'host', 'admin'))

stay_terms_nights_check.name: stay_terms_nights_check
stay_terms_nights_check.value: "min_nights" BETWEEN 1 AND 90 AND "max_nights" BETWEEN 1 AND 365 AND "min_nights" <= "max_nights"

stay_terms_money_check.name: stay_terms_money_check
stay_terms_money_check.value: ("weekend_price" IS NULL OR "weekend_price" > 0) AND ("cleaning_fee" IS NULL OR "cleaning_fee" >= 0)
